testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.persistence.JdbcWorkflowRunStoreTests

testcase.name: a failed sweep backs the run off and a successful one lifts only its own backoff()
a compare-and-set writes the run and the changed steps together and bumps the version()
a run awaiting an approval is re-examined at the approval interval, not at the short one()
create is idempotent per scope, a different fingerprint is KeyReused, TEST and LIVE and other users do not share a key()
a run that was just updated is not stale and is left alone()
get and list never cross tenants, list filters by app and returns newest first()
concurrent creates of one key produce exactly one run()
the claim is bounded per tenant()
a compare-and-set from a stale version fails and writes nothing, not even the steps()
a RUNNING run whose lease ran out is claimed even though it was updated recently()
a lease that expires exactly now counts as expired (lease_until is not after now)()
an in-flight run, its step attempts and its compensation progress are reconstructed exactly after a restart()
a finished run never carries a lease claim and a finished compensating run is still found by the stale rule()
of several concurrent compare-and-sets from one version exactly one wins()
a stuck compensation of a finished run is claimed, a finished run without one never is()
a run without a lease still falls back to the updated_at rule()
a due timer or retry is claimed before the run is stale, a future one is not()
redaction and purge only ever touch finished runs that are not compensating()
completed, failed and cancelled runs survive a restart with their outcome()
a renewal from a stale version loses and does not extend the lease()
a stale run is claimed once and stamped, a second sweeper gets nothing until the interval has passed()
process failures are counted per run and only for the right tenant()
a run in backoff is not claimed until its not-before has passed()
the lease is written by the claim, read back, renewed and cleared by compare-and-set, and survives a restart()
a compare-and-set cannot reach a run of another tenant()
a created run is stored with its definition, input and steps and read back identical()
a run for an application of another tenant, or with a foreign workspace, is refused and stores nothing()
a RUNNING run with a valid lease is left alone however old its updated_at is()
